name: job-progress
description: Live job progress: a worker reports progress over Redis pub/sub and the API relays it to SSE clients (combines bullmq + redis + sse).
instructions: Start Redis + Postgres:  docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
Run API and worker in separate terminals:  {{rootRun}} dev   /   {{apiRun}} dev:worker{{apiWorkspaceArg}}
Start a job:     curl -XPOST localhost:5002/progress -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"steps":5}'
The stream shows job-progress events 20 -> 40 -> ... -> 100 pushed from the worker via Redis.
